text: Nonuniform ALE transport and2D rotating shallow-water waves Time-advance conservative ALE transport on genuinely nonuniform moving cells with GCL, and2D linear rotating C-grid shallow-water waves. Saltzman pistons and global Williamson problems remain future work. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-moving-waves-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. ALE scalar transport on genuinely nonuniform moving cells Advance cell integrals and face positions with identical Heun stages, transporting a nonuniform analytic wave beyond a uniform GCL check.
